contract.tax_note: USD nett, non-commissionable. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes the hotel may add them from the date of implementation.
contract.child_policy_text: Child Policy (Maximum Up to 02 Children): Age of 0-5 Free of Charge. Age of 6-11.99: USD 30 (Per Child/Per Night on BB including Extra Bed), USD 45 (on HB including Extra Bed), USD 58 (on FB/AI including Extra Bed) (Not Applicable for Triple Occupancy); USD 10 (Per Child/Per Night on BB excluding Extra Bed), USD 25 (on HB excluding Extra bed), USD 38 (on FB/AI excluding Extra Bed). Baby cot can be provided on request - Free of Charge (Up to one cot per room).
contract.guide_policy_text: Driver Accommodation – Available. Guide/Tour leader Policy (Not Applicable from 20th Dec 2026 – 15th March 2027; only at Jetwing Lighthouse, Jetwing Yala & Jetwing Lagoon Wellness): Foreign Tour Leader – 20% discount on guest room rate for a Single room. 01 SGL room free of charge on the basis booked for minimum of 15 Pax up to 45 Pax. If less: BB – USD 70 | HB – USD 90 | FB – USD 105. Alternate accommodations in a full-house situation; if required on guaranteed basis the guest room rate is charged. The hotel may double up guides / transfer them in a full house.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellations within 07 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 14 days of the arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking. Cancellations within 21 days of the arrival date – 25% of the value of the booking. Group bookings, more than 8 rooms, will be liable to pay 50% of the basis booked before 30 days of arrival. For the periods of 21st Dec 2026 to 10th Jan 2027 & Feb 2027 Cancellations Before 28 days of arrival date – 50% of the value of the booking and Cancellations within 28 days of the arrival date – 100% of the value of the booking. This will apply to credit or non-credit agents. Only applicable for Jetwing Vil Uyana, Jetwing Lighthouse, Jetwing Saman Villas and Jetwing Yala (A Luxury Reserve).
contract.payment_text: Travel agents without credit facilities are required to make the relevant payment 05 days before the clients check into the hotel. Travel agents that are entitled to credit facilities should make necessary payments within one month of the departure of guests. For last minute/short notice bookings, 100% of the payment is to be made on confirmation. For the periods of 21st Dec 2026 to 10th Jan 2027 & Feb 2027, 50% of the payment is to be made on confirmation (hotel page: "Upon confirmation, 50% of the total booking amount will be collected as payment in advance to secure the booking"). This will apply to credit or non-credit agents. Only applicable for Jetwing Vil Uyana, Jetwing Lighthouse, Jetwing Saman Villas and Jetwing Yala (A Luxury Reserve).
contract.terms_text: JETWING YALA, A LUXURY RESERVE: Single Reduction – USD 20 | Triple Supplement – USD 40 | Quadruple Supplement (Family Room Only) – USD 60 (On BB); Single Reduction – USD 50 | Triple Supplement – USD 70 | Quadruple Supplement (Family Room Only) - USD 120 (On HB); Single Reduction – USD 75 | Triple Supplement – USD 95 | Quadruple Supplement (Family Room Only) – USD 170 (On FB); Single Reduction – USD 275 | Triple Supplement – USD 295 (On AI). All Inclusive: "Not Applicable for these room categories" for Luxury Room and Family Room. All Inclusive Package – Inclusions (Only Applicable for Jungle Dwelling and Jungle Dwelling with Pool room categories): Meals on Full board basis (dinner is with BBQ action stations optional). Premium liquor, Wine, Beer, Selected Cocktails and Non-alcoholic beverages included (Foreign/Local). One Game drive (Morning or Evening) including all park entry tickets in a luxury safari jeep (shared basis) accompanied by a Local area guide. Snacks and beverages (non-alcoholic) will be provided during game drives. Evening wildlife story sessions. EARLY BIRD OFFERS: Booked 75 days prior to arrival - 15% Discount; Booked 45 days prior to arrival - 10% Discount (Not Applicable for the stays during Super peak and month of February); Booked 75 days prior to arrival during Super peak and month of February - 10% Discount. VALUE ADDITIONS (Minimum 03 nights): Signature Dinner under the stars (once per stay); 15% Discount on Spa Treatments; 10% Discount on F&B (excluding tobacco products); Sunset cocktails for two (once per stay). Driver Accommodation – Available. Reservations resv.yala@jetwinghotels.com, +94 474710710 / +94 707684536. | VALUE ADDITIONS POLICY: A maximum of 03 value adds can be used at each property. Experiences like Tours/Walks/Demonstrations etc. will be arranged in common groups depending on the occupancy for the day. F&B discounts will not be applicable for liquor & tobacco. | JETWING LUXURY RESERVES COMBO OFFER: 10% discount for guests staying at a minimum of three (03) Jetwing Luxury Reserve properties within the same tour itinerary. Combinable with Early Bird Offer (EBO) and Stay Pay Offer. Year-round offer. Not applicable during the Super Peak period and the Month of February. All the Booking vouchers should send together to apply the Combo Offer. | GUEST AMENITIES (Jetwing Luxury Reserves): Check-In Experience – selection of welcome drink (items are subject to change without prior notice): alcoholic beverages Sparkling | Red or white wine | Beer (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness/Jetwing Lighthouse/Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa); non-alcoholic Herbal | Fruit juices | Tea | Coffee. Selection of welcome snacks: Savory | Sweet (room canapés in common area upon guest arrival at Jetwing Warwick Gardens and Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa). In-room Experience – one fully stocked complimentary mini bar per stay (items are subject to change without prior notice): alcoholic beverages (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness) Gin – Rockland Dry Gin 180ml | Arrack – Rockland Old Arrack Original | Beer – Lion Lager Bottle 330ml; non-alcoholic King Coconut Bottle (only item available at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness); aerated drinks Sparkling – Olu Tropical Sparkling 330ml | Coca Cola | Sprite | Pelican Island Soda | Pelican Island Tonic; snacks Nuts | Dehydrated Fruits (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness/Jetwing Lighthouse/Jetwing Wahawa Walauwa); non-alcoholic Herbal | Fruit juices | Tea | Coffee; in-room welcome canapes. Guest Relations – 24-hour personalized butler service (not applicable at Jetwing Lagoon Wellness and Jetwing Lighthouse); guest hosting with afternoon tea and snacks or cocktail hour with canapés; departure gift. | RATES: Rates are in USD and are non-commissionable. The accommodation rates are not valid for Meetings/Incentives/Conferences/Events/Exhibitions/Weddings. In case of an increase in taxes or any additional taxes, the hotel reserves the right to add such taxes to the rates from the date of implementation. Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets. Rates should not be published as hotel only rate on the internet by you or any other 3rd party. If such case occurs, the hotel has the right to withdraw the rate with immediate effect. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-in time is 14:00 and check-out time is 12:00 (noon). If an early check-in is required within 04 hours of the usual check-in time, 50% charge of the room rate will be applied. For late check-outs up to 04 hours past the original check-out time, a 50% room rate charge will apply. Late check outs past 04 hours will be charged for 100% room rate.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Jetwing Luxury Reserves - TA Contracted Rates - Winter 2026 & 2027.pdf" (14 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Currency "USD nett (Per room/Per night)", occupancy "Double Occupancy": the printed figure is the room at double occupancy; SGL / TPL / QUAD come from the single reduction / triple / quadruple supplements in the hotel's Terms and Conditions box (every row note gives the printed DBL and the arithmetic). Market list: "Rates cannot be extended to the domestic market or any other unspecified markets" → DOM excluded. No contract date, rate code, booking window or gala dinner is printed (PDF metadata says created 18 Aug 2026 — not printed on the sheet, so contract_date is empty). Early bird / stay-pay / combo offers are entered as offers, one row per stay range so they are not listed on Super Peak / February nights; the "booked 75/45 days prior" condition is in the offer text (no field for it). Room names: "Family Room (1 Room)" entered as the existing "Family"; "Luxury Room" (68 rooms), "Jungle Dwelling" (5) and "Jungle Dwelling with Pool" (5) are NEW room types (the hotel has Superior / Deluxe / Family — if "Luxury Room" is a renamed Superior or Deluxe, rename before saving). AI is printed only for the two Jungle Dwelling categories ("Not Applicable for these room categories" for Luxury / Family) and is a package (FB + premium drinks + one game drive with park entry tickets + wildlife story sessions) — whether the game drive is once per stay or per night is not stated. Quadruple supplement only for the Family Room, entered as QUAD = DBL + supplement (the sheet does not say whether it is added to the double or the triple). No Super Peak minimum stay is printed for Yala. Peak payment / cancellation for 21 Dec – 10 Jan and Feb 2027. Guide/tour-leader policy (page 14) applies here, except 20 Dec 2026 – 15 Mar 2027 (staff check).
